response.sql: WITH st AS (SELECT t.equipstatus AS es, AVG(s.pulsepersec) AS a FROM signals s JOIN telescopes t ON s.telescref = t.telescregistry GROUP BY t.equipstatus), m1 AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS m FROM st), k1 AS (SELECT st.es, st.a, st.a - m1.m AS ex1 FROM st, m1 WHERE st.a > m1.m), m2 AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS m FROM k1), k2 AS (SELECT k1.a, k1.ex1, k1.a - m2.m AS ex2 FROM k1, m2 WHERE k1.a > m2.m) SELECT AVG(a) AS avg_pulse_rate, AVG(ex1) AS avg_excess_first, AVG(ex2) AS avg_excess_second FROM k2
